mapper.sql: b.id, b.business_no, b.name, b.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, b.project_id, p.project_name, b.lead_id, b.owner_user_id, u.username AS owner_username, b.stage, b.amount, b.probability, b.expected_close_date, b.deal_date, b.source, b.source_type, b.source_url, b.source_title, b.remark, b.created_at, b.updated_at
FROM crm_business b JOIN ent_enterprise c ON c.id = b.customer_id LEFT JOIN crm_project p ON p.id = b.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = b.owner_user_id

sql.if: AND (b.name LIKE #{keyword} OR b.business_no LIKE #{keyword} OR c.name LIKE #{keyword} OR p.project_name LIKE #{keyword})

mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, project_id, owner_user_id, stage FROM crm_business WHERE lead_id = #{lead}
SELECT id FROM crm_business WHERE lead_id = #{lead} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, source_url, source_title FROM crm_business WHERE source_url_hash = #{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_business (business_no, name, customer_id, project_id, lead_id, owner_user_id, stage, amount, probability, expected_close_date, deal_date, source, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{businessNo}, #{name}, #{customer}, #{project}, #{lead}, #{owner}, #{stage}, #{amount}, #{probability}, #{expectedCloseDate}, #{dealDate}, #{source}, #{remark}, #{actor})

INSERT INTO crm_business (business_no, name, customer_id, project_id, owner_user_id, stage, amount, probability, source, remark, created_by, source_type, source_url, source_url_hash, source_title) VALUES (#{businessNo}, #{name}, #{customer}, #{project}, #{owner}, 'NEW', #{amount}, #{probability}, #{source}, #{remark}, #{actor}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceTitle})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_business SET stage = 'WON', deal_date = COALESCE(#{dealDate}, CURRENT_DATE) WHERE id = #{id} AND stage <> 'WON'
